forbidden: using any report value to choose K or centroids
using emotion category/context/stimulus identity to choose K
calling a report-transition family an emotion or cognitive state
interpreting rating_early activity as distortion, dishonesty, suppression, or exaggeration

multi_resolution_discovery.canonical_label_rule: lexicographic ordering of centroids in the fixed 14-cell coordinate order; never behavioral ordering
multi_resolution_discovery.no_eligible_K_rule: do not force discrete report-transition families; retain the continuous 14-cell report-transition signature and close only the discrete sub-branch

stability.comparison: ARI versus corresponding full Discovery K solution

next_if_eligible_K: specification and execute one-shot Validation structural transfer for all eligible report-transition K
next_if_no_eligible_K: continue with the fixed continuous report-transition signature; do not invent discrete families
primary_question: Does the transition from late stimulus processing into the rating/report stage contain stable cross-person structure that is distinct from the already fixed stimulus_early -> stimulus_late experience structure?

cross_person_standardization: within participant, robust-center each transformed signature cell by participant median
divide by participant IQR; use Discovery participant-balanced pooled IQR when local IQR <= 1e-8
participant_stage_preprocessing: for each participant and each stage separately, median-impute each of the 169 compact cells using that participant/stage only
divide by that participant/stage feature IQR
if stage IQR <= 1e-8, use participant-pooled stimulus_late+rating_early IQR for the same feature
if pooled IQR also <= 1e-8, use scale 1.0 and record local constancy

trial_signature.fixed_coordinate_order: [RMS, transformed cosine] for each of the six prespecified blocks in discovery_stimulus_experience_multiresolution_fit order, then [global RMS, global transformed cosine]
global: RMS displacement across all 169 compact cells
cosine similarity across all 169 compact cells
per_block: RMS displacement between standardized stimulus_late and rating_early profiles
cosine similarity between standardized stimulus_late and rating_early profiles

scientific_role: Discovery-only outcome-free multi-resolution structural analysis of stimulus_late -> rating_early EEG reconfiguration

metrics: ARI and NMI between each eligible report-transition K and each experience K on common trials
structural_comparison_after_discovery_re.purpose: quantify whether experience-period organization and report-stage transition organization are coupled; never use the experience labels to choose report-transition K
